newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Bicycle moves into black in '96.
newsitem.headline: China Bicycle moves into black in '96.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.06 yuan vs 0.11 yuan
Net assets per share 2.82 yuan vs 2.75 yuan
Company name: Shenzhen China Bicycle Co (Holdings) Ltd

Note: The results, published in an annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Wednesday, were calculated under Chinese accounting standards, except for the net profits which were based on international standards.
The 1995 loss figure was provided by a company spokeswoman.
Based on Chinese standards, the company posted net profits of 30.18 million yuan in 1996 against 51.25 million yuan for 1995.
The firm proposed no dividend for 1996, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting on May 30, the firm's annual report said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares was suspended on Wednesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said.
